visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short brown hair, wearing glasses and a white t-shirt, stands in a brightly lit modern kitchen area. He opens a silver refrigerator and looks inside with a confused facial expression, leaning his head forward. In the background, a woman in a pink shirt sits at a desk. (2) The scene shifts to the man sitting at a dark wooden desk looking at a laptop. A woman wearing a pink jacket and white headphones suddenly appears, grabbing the man's arm and looking at her wrist as if checking a watch. She then pulls him out of the frame. (3) The man is back at the desk, looking frustrated. He points toward a blue rectangular tissue box on the desk. The woman is seated next to him, rapidly pulling several white tissues from the box with her right hand. (4) The man holds a blue and white tissue package featuring a cartoon character (Doraemon) directly toward the camera. He points at the packaging with his index finger. The background is a studio wall with various snack packages on shelves. (5) Close-up shots follow: the man's hands pull a single white tissue sheet, stretching it out to demonstrate its texture. He then places the tissue on a desk surface to wipe a small puddle of clear liquid. (6) In the final phase, the man gives two thumbs up to the camera while smiling. The woman walks past him in the background carrying several large packs of tissues and a green tote bag, exiting through a metal door.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male voice expressing confusion at a moderate pitch. Low-volume upbeat background music with a steady synthesizer beat plays. A soft 'thud' sound occurs as a fridge door closes. (2) A female voice enters with high arousal and a fast speech rate, sounding urgent. The BGM maintains its tempo. (3) The male voice shifts to a lower intensity, internal monologue style. Distinct 'crisp rustling' sounds of paper being pulled from a box are heard repeatedly, synchronized with the visual of tissues being drawn. (4) A sharp 'pop' sound effect marks a transition. The male voice becomes highly energetic and authoritative, shifting into a promotional narrative tone. The BGM increases slightly in volume, featuring a bright electronic melody. (5) Sounds of paper being crinkled and a rhythmic 'frictional rubbing' sound are heard during a product demonstration. Each sound event is crisp with high spectral brightness. (6) The video concludes with the male voice giving a final enthusiastic call to action. A final 'click' and 'creak' sound of a door closing signals the end of the scene as the BGM fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Scenario -> Problem -> Product Introduction -> Feature Demonstration -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video uses a humorous 'office theft' scenario to introduce Tempo tissues and their Doraemon-themed collaboration, highlighting product benefits like thickness, strength, and lack of residue to encourage viewers to purchase the product.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of products, verbal promotion of features, and explicit mention of pricing and promotional dates.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively blends social-native comedy with direct response marketing. The high density of on-screen text and fast-paced audio editing is typical for high-engagement short-form video content.
